mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% over a 6-month window signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 4% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 3% signals improved supply capacity and cost pressures, which raise discount rates and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both the unemployment rate and payroll employment (UNRATE down and PAYEMS down) over a 3-month window signals a labor market mismatch, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE down AND PAYEMS down for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 600 thousand units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 4% combined with a 6-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% signals a synchronized demand-supply contraction, which reduces earnings and raises discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 4% YoY AND INDPRO falls > 2% for 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.
